feedback: The confession follows the previously available chain: Al's preview access, his later position beside the prepared glass, and his false identification of the red-and-silver scrap. Opening the bottle during the preview and dosing the glass are confessed actions, but they clarify the inferred method rather than introducing a new decisive clue needed to accuse him. The acknowledgment that the scrap was not a unique match preserves the evidential limitation honestly. His fear that publicity fraud would swallow his work connects to the earlier resin-versus-bronze admission. The waiting person at home turns the motive into an emotional consequence instead of an excuse. The innocent speeches give credible accountability, though their repeated documentary rebuttals keep the finale somewhat procedural.
